hardware_domain_median.contract: measured training target median within verified hardware domain with supported-train backoff

relative_nnls_token.contract: conditional_on_realized_native_workload_trace; output/completion counts are not prospective inputs; max_output_tokens is constant in this cohort and omitted

relative_nnls_token_cache.contract: conditional on realized native workload and cache trace; not prospective cache-state prediction

feature_contract.declared_constant_descriptor: max_output_tokens=2048 retained for provenance and omitted from the design
feature_contract.zero_target_policy: exact zero prediction passes; nonzero prediction is an infinite error; no epsilon is added

limitations: This is a development out-of-fold comparison on the repaired train_calibration population, not a sealed evaluator holdout.
All observations use one verified static H100 GPU inventory domain; cross-hardware accuracy is unvalidated.
Completion and cached-token counts are available only after a realized native request trace, so the token and cache candidates are conditional replay models and are not prospective online forecasts.
Native E2E is reported directly; queue/prefill/decode diagnostics are separate and are never summed into an E2E claim.
The report does not claim the literal D9 all-event acceptance gate from aggregate coverage metrics.

rejected_log_diagnostic.correction: scaled nonnegative linear token design; cache candidate uses uncached prompt and prompt-completion interaction with phase-specific prefill/decode designs
rejected_log_diagnostic.reason: log1p features underfit the near-linear completion-token workload and were replaced before the final fixed comparison
